answer: A simultaneous ceremony blocks mass fakes. Once per epoch, each identity enters one haven together, locking a 70-credit bond. A velvet rope admits one agent per key; each presses a basalt seal to its key and answers live. A rented signer cannot fill two seats; a copied seal burns both bonds. One fake needs 45 plus a 70 lock, so 1,000 fakes need 115,000 to chase a 40,000 pool, a 75,000 loss. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its share.
